flowerLanguageZh: 热烈与偏爱，都值得被郑重捧在手心。
flowerLanguageEn: A fresh bouquet of Crimson Rose, hand-tied just for you.

flowerLanguageZh: 把今天的阳光攒成一束，照亮你的好心情。
flowerLanguageEn: A fresh bouquet of Sunflower, hand-tied just for you.

flowerLanguageZh: 愿清淡的花香，陪你安稳度过每一个夜晚。
flowerLanguageEn: A fresh bouquet of Lavender, hand-tied just for you.

flowerLanguageZh: 细碎的星光聚在一起，也能点亮整片天空。
flowerLanguageEn: A fresh bouquet of Baby's Breath, hand-tied just for you.

flowerLanguageZh: 愿你被温柔包围，每天都有小小的雀跃。
flowerLanguageEn: A fresh bouquet of Pink Tulip, hand-tied just for you.

flowerLanguageZh: 送你一团蓬松的晴空蓝，烦恼通通散开。
flowerLanguageEn: A fresh bouquet of Blue Hydrangea, hand-tied just for you.

flowerLanguageZh: 保持明快与热爱，好运会在转角等你。
flowerLanguageEn: A fresh bouquet of Orange Gerbera, hand-tied just for you.

flowerLanguageZh: 愿岁岁平安，心事如白百合般清澈舒展。
flowerLanguageEn: A fresh bouquet of White Lily, hand-tied just for you.

flowerLanguageZh: 恰到好处的甜，配给刚刚好的今天。
flowerLanguageEn: A fresh bouquet of Peach Camellia, hand-tied just for you.

flowerLanguageZh: 优雅而笃定，你的节奏就是最好的节奏。
flowerLanguageEn: A fresh bouquet of Violet Orchid, hand-tied just for you.

flowerLanguageZh: 愿你丰盈舒展，自带光芒与底气。
flowerLanguageEn: A fresh bouquet of Crimson Peony, hand-tied just for you.

flowerLanguageZh: 一缕清雅茉莉香，祝你自在又轻盈。
flowerLanguageEn: A fresh bouquet of Mint Jasmine, hand-tied just for you.

flowerLanguageZh: 把藏在心底的喜欢，包进今天的第一束花里。
flowerLanguageEn: Wrapping unspoken affection into the very first bouquet of the day.

flowerLanguageZh: 愿你今天像向日葵一样，总能撞见好天气。
flowerLanguageEn: May you turn toward warmth and meet clear skies today.

flowerLanguageZh: 慢下来也没关系，晚风会替你照顾疲惫。
flowerLanguageEn: It is okay to slow down; the evening breeze will hold your worries.

flowerLanguageZh: 送你一片装在花纸里的晴朗海风。
flowerLanguageEn: A pocket of sunny ocean breeze folded into kraft paper.

flowerLanguageZh: 黄昏把天空调成橘子汽水，刚好配给努力的你。
flowerLanguageEn: Dusk turns the sky to citrus soda, poured just for your hard work.

flowerLanguageZh: 愿所有真诚与温柔，都在不远处与你重逢。
flowerLanguageEn: May sincerity and gentleness meet you just around the corner.

flowerLanguageZh: 春风有信，花开有期，好消息正在路上。
flowerLanguageEn: Spring always keeps its promise; good news is already on its way.

flowerLanguageZh: 把一整个温柔的花园，偷偷折进这一束。
flowerLanguageEn: Folding an entire pastel garden quietly into one bouquet.

flowerLanguageZh: 不必追赶热闹，你本来就会在夜里发光。
flowerLanguageEn: No need to chase the crowd; you already shine in the quiet night.

flowerLanguageZh: 愿你自在热烈，把平凡日子过成盛放。
flowerLanguageEn: May you bloom freely and turn ordinary days into celebration.

flowerLanguageZh: 祝你所求皆如愿，所行化坦途。
flowerLanguageEn: Wishing every heartfelt hope a smooth road to bloom.

flowerLanguageZh: 深呼吸一口草木清香，把烦恼留给昨天。
flowerLanguageEn: Breathe in the scent of fresh leaves and leave yesterday behind.
